title: Extend depth sweep: DEPTH=10 -> 12
description: Set DEPTH=12 (model_dim 640->768, 6 heads); at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 (matching depth=10 setup) this OOMs, so DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE was reduced to 64 (grad_accum 2->4) to fit memory.
reflection: depth=12 at batch=64 gives val_bpb 1.016138, clearly worse than the depth=10 baseline (1.002279) and even worse than the original depth=8 baseline (1.014027). The depth=10->12 step does not continue the depth=8->10 trend -- the local optimum for this time/token budget appears to be at or near depth=10. Note this result is confounded by the forced batch-size reduction (needed to avoid OOM at depth=12), which increases per-step overhead and could itself hurt throughput within the fixed 5-min wall-clock budget; a batch=128 depth=12 run crashed with OOM (79GB card, ~78GB in use) so that comparison isn't directly available. Future depth sweeps should treat 10-11 as the likely local optimum and not push depth further without also budgeting for the batch-size/VRAM tradeoff, or should first shrink ASPECT_RATIO/HEAD_DIM to keep VRAM in check before adding more layers.
